verdict.rationale: Gazebo separates a headless server from a GUI that runs as a client and connects to it (-s / -g flags, a GUI-free server package). It also exposes programmatic control through Gazebo Transport (pub/sub, service calls, discovery, socket-based remote interfacing), CLI tools for introspection and control, and gz-sim as a C++ library. Together these suggest much of what the GUI does is reachable without it, but no source states that the API matches the UI feature for feature. missing for 10: an explicit documented claim that the API/CLI matches every GUI action, a reference mapping GUI operations to transport services/CLI commands, independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.
